How to read this page

Each object is connected change of one sign found by M3C2 between the corrected 2011–2013 lidar and 3DEP: core points every metre on the 3DEP ground whose distance exceeds its 95% level of detection and a minimum magnitude, grouped with DBSCAN in plan view. Red is surface loss (bank retreat, scour, cut), blue is build-up (deposition, fill). Each object is a candidate; the label says what it is, or that it is an artefact.

The map shows every object. A stratified sample, by kind, area and distance to water, also has a 3-D scene: both point clouds, the M3C2 core points, and both grounds draped with photos of about the same years. The photos were not taken on the lidar flight days.

Labels stay in this browser until you copy them out. Send the copied GeoJSON back; it is merged with ilcd viz_label import-labels, which adds each object's outline.
